actions.name: Meet the team
actions.description: Team meeting enables you to meet the team in person and outline your goals for the weeks ahead. You could use the opportunity to gauge feedback from the team members as well. This action will take 1 day to complete.

options.label: Present the overall strategy, get into details of the execution plan and explain the responsibilities of the teams.
Energize the team by giving a pep talk. At the same time, you try to get a buy-in for your strategy and execution plan.
Present the overall strategy and ask for feedback.
Ask the team to brainstorm on the strategy and the execution plan

actions.name: Energize the team
actions.description: Energize your team by either taking them out for a team lunch or organize a 2-day team building activity.

options.label: Team Lunch
Team building activity

actions.name: Send email
actions.description: Write to up to 3 people. Congratulate or warn; replies arrive in your inbox.

options.label: Send warning mail
Send congratulatory mail

actions.name: Send for training
actions.description: Build skill away from the desk. Up to 3 people.

options.label: Send for 3-day training
Send for 1 week workshop

actions.name: Swap roles
actions.description: Move people between stages, then explain the decision to them.

options.label: Reassign role
Swap role

actions.name: Hire member
actions.description: Interview candidates for an open seat.

options.label: You decide to hire fresh talent into the team. We have provided you with the following options. Choose wisely.

actions.name: Let go
actions.description: Remove someone from the team, then have the exit conversation.

options.label: Use this action to fire a member from a role. Please note that you are required to have atleast one member in the role after the Fire action is taken.
Get into details of the execution plan and explain the tasks in detail.
Energize the person by providing emotional support and try to seek an agreement on your execution plan.
Discuss the role and performance of the person and ask for feedback.
Encourage the person to follow own processes.

actions.name: Assess member
actions.description: See how this person would do in another stage. No effect on them.

options.label: Assess action helps you to evaluate a team member's expertise and motivation levels with respect to a new role. Prior to reassigning a member, you may use the Assess action to determine the most suited role for him / her.

actions.name: Reward member
actions.description: Recognize someone, then tell them why.

options.label: Awarding bonus to your team members may boost their morale and enhance their performance.

actions.name: Set goals
actions.description: Agree goals, measures and support for the week.

options.label: Send team member's tasks and the milestones for the upcoming week.
Seek buy-in from team member for the current week's plan and be available for any help required.
Send the plan for the week and seek inputs on it.
Ask team member what he / she is focusing on this week.

actions.name: Coach member
actions.description: Work through the job with them.

options.label: Handhold the person with the execution plan and provide detailed instructions to deal with the task at hand.
Provide detailed guidance on execution and help the person see the importance of your instructions.
Work closely with the person to solve problems collaboratively.
Ask questions to provide clarity to the person.

actions.name: Give feedback
actions.description: Tell them how it is going and agree what changes.

options.label: Provide step-by-step feedback on things that have gone well and things that haven't.
Provide detailed feedback on performance and encourage the person to stick to your action plan.
Collaboratively assess the performance and come up with an action plan.
Ask the person to do self assessment and validate it.

body.he: Your firm has adopted a new CRM system and employees are forced to input leads electronically. Some are not tech savvy and do not like the change.
body.she: Your firm has adopted a new CRM system and employees are forced to input leads electronically. Some are not tech savvy and do not like the change.

body.she: An elevator review website criticizes the features of Levo. It claims that the features already exist in competitor's products and are not innovative.

body.he: {name}'s performance suddenly declines. You find out that due to personal reasons, he's not been performing well and could be a roadblock for others to act on their leads.
body.she: {name}'s performance suddenly declines. You find out that due to personal reasons, she's not been performing well and could be a roadblock for others to act on their leads.

body.he: In your 360-degree feedback, employees have mentioned that they're out of energy and are in dire need of a break.
body.she: In your 360-degree feedback, employees have mentioned that they're out of energy and are in dire need of a break.

body.he: Recession strikes. Salaries across the company are lowered and you (the Sales Director) are asked to lower salaries of your team members.
body.she: Recession strikes. Salaries across the company are lowered and you (the Sales Director) are asked to lower salaries of your team members.

body.he: There are some serious rumors that Levo might be acquired by Uplift. The sales team finds it hard to convince customers that there is no risk of products getting abandoned even in case an acquisition might go through.

body.she: {name} gets a job offer from your competitor, Uplift. The fabulous pay package and promotion makes it hard for her to refuse the offer.

body.he: CEO announces that this year's sales conference will happen in a local resort, as opposed to the usual exotic destinations. Sales professionals expecting to cool their heels in Hawaii this year are terribly disappointed.
body.she: CEO announces that this year's sales conference will happen in a local resort, as opposed to the usual exotic destinations. Sales professionals expecting to cool their heels in Hawaii this year are terribly disappointed.

body.he: Tragic accident strikes passengers in a Levo elevator in a high-rise in New York. This does damage to the brand, making it hard for the sales team to close sales.
body.she: Tragic accident strikes passengers in a Levo elevator in a high-rise in New York. This does damage to the brand, making it hard for the sales team to close sales.

body.he: A business process change in the company necessitates stringent sales compliance measures. This has introduced multiple approvals before sales can be closed. The sales team finds itself encumbered with needless paperwork, making them inefficient.
body.she: A business process change in the company necessitates stringent sales compliance measures. This has introduced multiple approvals before sales can be closed. The sales team finds itself encumbered with needless paperwork, making them inefficient.

body.he: Levo's long-time board member, Aaron king, gets embroiled in an insider trading scandal. This brings a lot of disrepute to the company. {name} tells you that he is embarrassed to meet clients who often ask him about the latest developments in the scandal.
body.she: Levo's long-time board member, Aaron king, gets embroiled in an insider trading scandal. This brings a lot of disrepute to the company. {name} tells you that she is embarrassed to meet clients who often ask her about the latest developments in the scandal.
